issues.issue: This line is 28.6% of business-type receipts and is filed as 'other'. Nothing on the form breaks it down. For an airport it is probably hangar rent, fuel sales or other fees (charges for services/fees). It stays a review item.
No airport function exists in the category list, so 'other' with review can be defended. It is still 48% of spending sitting in a last-resort category.
Line doesn't say if this is principal, interest or fees. The extractor chose interest. The budget-form rule for combined debt payments uses debt service principal, so this is a judgment call.
